shared_research_reports.Report Title: The Price of the Frontier: What It Actually Costs to Build and Run a Frontier AI Company
shared_research_reports.Thesis: Frontier AI is the most capital-intensive technology category in history. This report answers three questions: (1) What does it actually cost to found a frontier AI company? (2) What does it cost to run one at scale? (3) How does compute independence — the degree to which a company controls its own training and inference infrastructure — determine the long-term cost structure and competitive destiny of every player in the field? Primary comparison: OpenAI vs Anthropic. Supporting analysis: SSI, Mistral AI, Cohere, xAI, Cursor, and the next generation of challengers.
